description: This file defines the Nested formatter class within the SCSSPHP library, which is used to format SCSS code with nested indentation styles. The class is marked as deprecated and provides methods to handle indentation, block formatting, and nested structure rendering for SCSS output.

classes.name: Nested
classes.description: A formatter class for handling nested SCSS code formatting, included in the SCSSPHP package. It manages nested blocks, indentation, and line formatting, but is deprecated in favor of the Expanded formatter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the formatter with default indentation and formatting settings, and triggers a deprecation warning indicating that this formatter is deprecated.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns the indentation string based on the current depth level for nested blocks.

methods.name: blockLines
methods.description: Handles the formatting of the lines within a block, applying indentation and line breaks.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Main method that manages the rendering of a block, including nested levels, selectors, and child blocks.

methods.name: hasFlatChild
methods.description: Checks if a given output block has at least one child with no selectors, indicating a flat child structure.
